faq.question: What platform formats and sizes does Nano Banana Pro support for social media?
faq.answer: Lovart's Nano Banana Pro generates graphics optimized for every major platform: Instagram (square 1080×1080, portrait 1080×1350, Stories 1080×1920), Pinterest (1000×1500, 1000×2000), TikTok (1080×1920), and Facebook Ads (1200×628, 1080×1080, 1080×1920). All graphics are generated at 8K base resolution for pixel-perfect quality on any device.

faq.question: How much does Lovart cost for social media graphics creation?
faq.answer: Lovart offers Free (daily credits for testing), Starter ($2,000/month with commercial license), Basic ($3,500/month with priority rendering and bulk generation), and Pro ($11,000/month with unlimited generations, PSD layered exports, and dedicated rendering queue). All paid plans include full commercial usage rights for social media advertising and organic content.

faq.question: What is MCoT and how does it improve social media graphics?
faq.answer: MCoT (Multi-Chain of Thought) is Lovart's proprietary AI architecture that processes your graphic brief through 5 parallel reasoning chains. For social media, these chains simultaneously optimize for platform-native aspect ratios, visual trend alignment, text readability at mobile sizes, brand color consistency, and engagement-psychology-driven layout. This multi-dimensional approach produces graphics that perform better than those from single-path models that treat all platforms identically.

faq.question: Can I use Lovart-generated social media graphics in paid ads?
faq.answer: Absolutely. All graphics generated on paid plans — Starter ($2,000/mo), Basic ($3,500/mo), or Pro ($11,000/mo) — include full commercial usage rights. You can deploy them in Facebook Ads, Instagram sponsored posts, TikTok Spark Ads, Pinterest promoted pins, and any other paid social campaign without attribution, royalty, or additional licensing fees.

faq.question: What is ChatCanvas and how does it help with social media graphics?
faq.answer: ChatCanvas is Lovart's conversational image editing interface. For social media graphics, you can refine designs by chatting: 'Move the headline to the top,' 'Change the CTA button to neon green,' 'Add a countdown timer element,' or 'Make the background more festive.' ChatCanvas applies targeted edits while preserving the rest of your design, making it perfect for creating multiple ad variants from one base design.

faq.question: How many free daily credits do I get for social media graphics?
faq.answer: Every Lovart account receives free daily credits that refresh every 24 hours, typically allowing 5–10 social media graphic generations per day. Free credits let you test all platform formats — Instagram carousels, Pinterest pins, TikTok thumbnails, Facebook ads — with full MCoT processing and ChatCanvas refinement. Upgrade to Starter ($2,000/mo), Basic ($3,500/mo), or Pro ($11,000/mo) for unlimited commercial generation.

faq.question: Can I maintain brand consistency across all my social media graphics?
faq.answer: Yes. Lovart allows you to define brand guidelines — color palettes, typography families, logo placement rules, and visual style preferences — that Nano Banana Pro applies consistently across every generated graphic. The MCoT engine's brand-consistency reasoning chain ensures your Instagram carousels, Pinterest pins, and Facebook ads all feel unmistakably part of the same brand system, regardless of platform-specific format differences.

faq.question: What file formats can I export social media graphics in?
faq.answer: Lovart exports social media graphics in PNG (lossless, platform-standard), JPG (compressed for faster upload), SVG (vector format for icons, logos, and scalable elements), and PSD (layered Photoshop files — Pro plan at $11,000/mo — for teams that need to hand off to designers for additional editing). All exports match the exact pixel dimensions required by their target platform.

faq.question: How does Lovart compare to Canva or Adobe Express for social media graphics?
faq.answer: Canva and Adobe Express are template-based design tools — you manually arrange elements within a fixed layout. Lovart is the world's first AI Design Agent: you describe what you want, and Nano Banana Pro's MCoT engine generates a complete, original graphic optimized for your platform. ChatCanvas then lets you refine conversationally rather than clicking through panels. Lovart produces unique 8K designs in seconds versus manual template editing; it's a generative creator, not a canvas tool. Paid plans start at $2,000/mo (Starter), $3,500/mo (Basic), and $11,000/mo (Pro) with commercial licenses.

section_zh-TW.heading: 全球社群媒體團隊的信賴之選

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.quote: 我們為 47 個品牌管理社群媒體。在 Lovart 之前，設計團隊是瓶頸——每張圖平均需要 3 天。現在我們用 Pro 方案每月生成 850+ 張社群圖形。Instagram 輪播互動率提高 67%，每個品牌的設計週期縮短至不到 2 小時。

testimonials.name: Alex Thompson
testimonials.quote: 使用 Lovart 後，我們的 Facebook 廣告創意測試從每季度 12 個變體提升到每月 220+ 個。我們在大規模下對縮圖、標題處理和配色方案進行 A/B 測試。Basic 方案 $3,500/月取代了 $18,000/月的自由設計師成本，廣告 CTR 提升了 34%。

testimonials.name: Camille Dubois
testimonials.role: 內容創作者，230 萬粉絲
testimonials.quote: 作為一名擁有 230 萬粉絲的獨立創作者，我需要每天在 3 個平台發佈 4 次內容。Lovart 的 Nano Banana Pro 在幾秒內生成我的 Pinterest Pin 和 TikTok 縮圖——僅今年我已發佈了超過 2,800 張 AI 設計的圖形。粉絲根本分辨不出與手工作品的差別，而我每週省下了 30 小時。

faq.question: Nano Banana Pro 支援哪些社群媒體平台格式和尺寸？
faq.answer: Lovart 的 Nano Banana Pro 為每個主流平台生成優化的圖形：Instagram（方形 1080×1080、豎版 1080×1350、Stories 1080×1920）、Pinterest（1000×1500、1000×2000）、TikTok（1080×1920）和 Facebook Ads（1200×628、1080×1080、1080×1920）。所有圖形均以 8K 基礎解析度生成，在任何裝置上均呈現像素完美的畫質。

faq.question: Lovart 社群媒體圖形建立如何收費？
faq.answer: Lovart 提供 Free（每日試用額度）、Starter（$2,000/月，含商業授權）、Basic（$3,500/月，含優先渲染和批量生成）和 Pro（$11,000/月，無限制生成量、PSD 分層匯出、專屬渲染佇列）。所有付費方案均包含社群媒體廣告和自然內容的完整商業使用權。

faq.question: 什麼是 MCoT，它如何改進社群媒體圖形？
faq.answer: MCoT（多鏈思維推理）是 Lovart 獨有的 AI 架構，透過 5 條並行推理鏈處理你的圖形需求。針對社群媒體，這些推理鏈同時最佳化平台原生寬高比、視覺趨勢對齊、行動端文字可讀性、品牌色一致性和互動心理學驅動的佈局。這種多維度的方案生成的圖形表現遠超將所有平台一視同仁的單路徑模型。

faq.question: 我可以將 Lovart 生成的社群媒體圖形用於付費廣告嗎？
faq.answer: 當然可以。所有在付費方案——Starter（$2,000/月）、Basic（$3,500/月）或 Pro（$11,000/月）——上生成的圖形均包含完整商業使用權。你可以將它們部署在 Facebook Ads、Instagram 贊助貼文、TikTok Spark Ads、Pinterest 推廣 Pin 以及任何其他付費社群活動中，無需署名、版稅或額外許可費。

faq.question: 什麼是 ChatCanvas，它如何幫助社群媒體圖形製作？
faq.answer: ChatCanvas 是 Lovart 的對話式圖像編輯介面。對於社群媒體圖形，你可以透過對話來精修設計：「把標題移到頂部」「將 CTA 按鈕改為螢光綠」「添加倒數計時元素」或「讓背景更有節日氛圍」。ChatCanvas 在保留其餘設計的同時應用定向編輯，非常適合從一個基礎設計建立多個廣告變體。

faq.question: 社群媒體圖形每天可獲得多少免費額度？
faq.answer: 每個 Lovart 帳戶均可獲得每日免費生成額度，每 24 小時刷新一次，通常每天可生成 5–10 張社群媒體圖形。免費額度讓你可以測試所有平台格式——Instagram 輪播、Pinterest Pin、TikTok 縮圖、Facebook 廣告——並完整體驗 MCoT 處理和 ChatCanvas 精修。升級至 Starter（$2,000/月）、Basic（$3,500/月）或 Pro（$11,000/月）以獲得無限制商業生成。

faq.question: 能否讓所有社群媒體圖形保持品牌一致性？
faq.answer: 可以。Lovart 允許你定義品牌準則——配色方案、字體家族、標誌擺放規則和視覺風格偏好——Nano Banana Pro 會在每張生成的圖形中一致應用。MCoT 引擎的品牌一致性推理鏈確保你的 Instagram 輪播、Pinterest Pin 和 Facebook 廣告無論平台格式差異如何，都明顯屬於同一品牌體系。

faq.question: 社群媒體圖形可以匯出為哪些檔案格式？
faq.answer: Lovart 可將社群媒體圖形匯出為 PNG（無損、平台標準格式）、JPG（壓縮格式，上傳更快）、SVG（向量格式，適用於圖示、標誌和可縮放元素）和 PSD（分層 Photoshop 檔案——Pro 方案 $11,000/月——供需要將檔案交給設計師進一步編輯的團隊使用）。所有匯出檔案均精確匹配目標平台所需的像素尺寸。

faq.question: Lovart 在社群媒體圖形方面與 Canva 或 Adobe Express 相比如何？
faq.answer: Canva 和 Adobe Express 是基於模板的設計工具——你需要手動在固定佈局內排列元素。Lovart 是全球首個 AI 設計代理：你描述想要的內容，Nano Banana Pro 的 MCoT 引擎即生成針對你平台最佳化的完整原創圖形。ChatCanvas 則讓你透過對話而非點擊面板進行精修。Lovart 在數秒內產出獨特的 8K 設計，而非手動編輯模板；它是生成式創作者，而非畫布工具。付費方案起價 $2,000/月（Starter）、$3,500/月（Basic）和 $11,000/月（Pro），均含商業授權。
